articles.chapeau: How to start the brainwashing Easter egg
articles.txt:
The brainwashing Easter egg in Grand Theft Auto 6 is a long side mission in which you get the chance to investigate long-forgotten bunkers where a certain president spent some time (and listened to rumba) and where brainwashing experiments had taken place. Like the Vice City portal Easter egg , you'll need to go through a series of steps to finish this mission, but there's no other option if you want to learn the truth about what the government hid from you.
To help you uncover the mystery regarding President Russo, here's how to start the 'Kill The President' Easter egg in GTA 6 and how to complete it.
Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games To start the "Kill the President" quest chain, you must talk to José Bermúdez , a man sitting in front of the Joe Russo monument in Downtown , Vice City. Be sure to visit him during the day ! Choose to ask "What really happened?" after he starts talking. José will tell you to visit his apartment in a salmon-colored building with Cuban flags on Little Cuba NW 4th avenue if you want to know the truth.
Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games Go to his place to find the blueprint of a bunker on the wall, some recordings, and a picture showing President Russo on Sharktooth Island — your next destination. Before you go, be sure to listen to the recording and pay attention to what President Russo says, as he'll tell you the code for the next area.
Travel northeast on the map to find Sharktooth Island, on the southern side of Little Hardin Island in Leonard County . Once you reach the island, head northwest to find the bunker entrance and a keypad lock that requires a six-digit number.
Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games Unfortunately, you won't find the code on the island. The information you need to figure out the code was shared by President Russo himself in the recording you found in José's apartment . Now, if you don't want to return to the apartment just to listen to the recording again, don't worry. The code to open the bunker is 010317 .
As you enter the bunk, turn right to find an electrical box. Pull the lever up to turn the lights on, then head in the opposite direction. After passing through a couple of small rooms, you will get to a larger room where you'll find some beds and a presidential desk beside a large safe.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon Sit in the chair behind the desk and look to your right for the "Search drawer" option to appear. Next, pick up the phone. Inside the drawer, you will find a file with three different number sequences listed below the word "Protocol." Keep these in mind.
Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games The next step is to return to one of the first rooms you passed through and listen to the recordings , in which someone mentions the number "5297" and "protocol two." These are the clues you need to open the safe.
If you want a quick answer to how to open the safe in the presidential bunker, you need to move the last number to the front to get the safe code, which is 2975. Inside, you will find Russo's 1922 pistol and a photo . It appears to show part of the map with arrows pointing to a specific location. If you flip it , you can read the word "OBSESS" on the back of the photo. Now, it's time to locate the place in the photo.
The photo you found inside the safe in the presidential bunker shows the location of another bunker in Grassrivers, Mariana County . You can reach it by heading southwest from the Richardson Hunting Supplies shop , but you can't enter through the main entrance. Instead, you will need to open the hatch , which you find to the northeast .
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon As expected of a secret bunker, the hatch is locked, and you will need to enter a six-digit number to open it. Luckily, you've opened the safe in the presidential bunker and seen the word behind the photo . Don't you think some letters look like numbers? If you make the numbers out, you'll get 085355 .
Graphic: Paulo Kawanishi/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games Once you're inside the bunker, there isn't much to do besides make your way through the rooms on the left side to reach the electrical box and turn on the lights. Next, return to the starting portion of the area and follow the path through the rooms on the right side until you reach a half-open metal door leading to a control room.

articles.chapeau: Jeu et phénomène culturel à l’ampleur mondiale, GTA VI est désormais disponible sur console. Mais où l’obtenir dans sa version boîte au meilleur prix ? La réponse se trouve du côté de chez Auchan, Micromania et E. Leclerc
articles.txt:
Treize ans après un GTA V qui culmine aujourd’hui à plus de 230 millions d’unités vendues, Rockstar Games est de retour avec Grand Theft Auto VI et les attentes étaient tout simplement énormes. Chaque déclaration, image, fuite, bande-annonce et présentation ont été décortiquées dans tous les sens pour en savoir plus sur un titre qui restait malgré tout assez mystérieux. Le 18 novembre, l’embargo sur la presse est tombé et celle-ci a gratifié GTA 6 d’une note moyenne agrégée de 99 sur 100 sur le site Metacritic après plus de 150 tests publiés. Peu après la sortie, l’éditeur Take-Two a révélé que GTA 6 et les aventures criminelles de Jason et Lucia avaient généré 3,79 milliards de dollars avant sa sortie pour plus de 32,5 millions d’unités précommandées. C’est le plus gros lancement d’un produit culturel de toute l’histoire, tout simplement. Si vous souhaitez vous le procurer au meilleur prix sur PS5, voici les trois enseignes où il est affiché au meilleur prix.
Découvrez Vice City et l’État de Leonida pour 79,99 euros chez Auchan en profitant de la version boîte de GTA VI. Cette version propose donc une boîte PS5 contenant un code de téléchargement, mais également un poster réversible. En passant par Auchan, vous pourrez profiter du retrait en 1 h en magasin.
Chez Micromania, GTA VI est également affiché au prix de 79,99 euros dans sa version boîte sur PS5, mais vous tourner vers l’enseigne spécialisée vous permet, d’une part, de récupérer 800 points de fidélité sur votre carte et, d’autre part, de baisser le prix à 39,99 euros en revendant un jeu ou un accessoire figurant sur la liste des produits éligibles. Cliquez ici pour profiter de l’offre sur GTA 6
On termine avec E. Leclerc, qui affiche cette même version boîte de GTA VI sur PS5 au prix de 69,99 euros. Là encore, il s’agit d’une boîte de jeu contenant un code de téléchargement ainsi qu’un poster, mais vous profitez de la remise immédiate et d’une livraison offerte en Click&Collect.
Ce qu’il faut retenir sur GTA 6 : GTA 6 est un jeu d’action et d’aventure à la 3e personne en mode ouvert très vivant, plein d’activités, ultra-réaliste et d’une scénarisation très avancée. En histoire, secrets et découverte, GTA 6 vous immerge pleinement dans son univers.

Sony's standard DualSense controllers—the mainstay for controller for the PS5—don't have the hall effect sticks and triggers we might hope for, let alone TMR tech. But they do have Sony's proprietary adaptive trigger tech, which provide some delightful tactility in games that support it.
Key specs: Wireless and Wired | Adaptive triggers | Symmetrical
I spent years using a DualShock 4 for my controller-based PC gaming, back when it was more likely that you'd have to rely on community-made input mappers that would inevitably decide to arm wrestle with Steam Input for controller dominance. It eventually got to be enough of a headache that I bit the bullet, switching over to Xbox controllers and 8bitdo alternatives.
I've been borrowing a friend's PS5 for the launch of GTA 6 , and after getting reacquainted with PlayStation controller hardware, I've been realizing how much I've been missing by not giving the DualSense its fair shake. Like our Morgan Park, I've been enamored with GTA 6's use of haptic feedback . I'm an adaptive trigger convert now, and thanks to Black Friday deals, I can grab a DualSense for $54 at Walmart and revel in the dynamic trigger technology I've been sorely missing.
It's time to go back to the old me. But like, a little newer. The newer old me. Do you know what I'm saying?
While it'll be nice to have a DualSense on hand for GTA 6's eventual PC launch—whenever that ends up being—I've been operating under the assumption that it's otherwise a bit of a wasteland in terms of adaptive trigger support on PC. Thanks to this handy list of games that support DualSense adaptive triggers from PCGamingWiki , however, that misconception has been dispelled. A lot of games I love are on here! I could've been enjoying Ace Combat 8 with the controller triggers doing things other than vibrating slightly! I've been a fool.
Better late than never, I guess. And better a $54 controller than a $75 one.

articles.chapeau: Une vidéo promet GTA 6 à 180 images par seconde sur PC, en format ultra-large et avec ray tracing. Le compteur oublie simplement de préciser que cinq
articles.txt:
À en croire une séquence qui tourne sur X depuis le début d’après-midi, GTA 6 tournerait déjà six fois mieux sur un PC pirate que sur une PS5 Pro.
Son auteur, D Everett Hinton, affirme dans une vidéo publiée sur X atteindre 30 images par seconde natives, propulsées à 180 grâce à la génération d’images, le tout en HDR10+ avec un moteur graphique « entièrement réécrit ».
Il assure au passage que la plupart des autres extraits en ligne sont faux, contrairement au sien. Pourtant, son nom n’apparaît dans aucun des projets recensés par les sites qui suivent la course des portages , et pas une seule ligne de code n’a été publiée.
GTA 6 PC port with 5120×1440 32:9, 30fps (at 16:9) and 180fps with frame gen, HDR 10+, Nvidia Reflex, etc, with ray reconstruction and DLSS 5 NR coming soon.. most of the videos you see are fake, this one is not! Completely rewritten CPU/GPU pipeline. pic.twitter.com/OjZXboxqQH
Ce contenu est bloqué car vous n’avez pas accepté les cookies et autres traceurs. Ce contenu est fourni par Twitter. Pour pouvoir le visualiser, vous devez accepter l’usage étant opéré par Twitter avec vos données qui pourront être utilisées pour les finalités suivantes : vous permettre de visualiser et de partager des contenus avec des médias sociaux, favoriser le développement et l’amélioration des produits d’Humanoid et de ses partenaires, vous afficher des publicités personnalisées par rapport à votre profil et activité, vous définir un profil publicitaire personnalisé, mesurer la performance des publicités et du contenu de ce site et mesurer l’audience de ce site (en savoir plus)
En cliquant sur « J’accepte tout », vous consentez aux finalités susmentionnées pour l’ensemble des cookies et autres traceurs déposés par Humanoid et ses partenaires .
Vous gardez la possibilité de retirer votre consentement à tout moment. Pour plus d’informations, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance de notre Politique cookies .
En regardant l’extrait de plus près, les zones d’ombre s’accumulent vite. La vidéo se limite au prologue de la prison, en intérieur, loin de la charge d’un monde ouvert ou d’une course-poursuite en voiture.
L’image est vendue comme du 32:9 (le format des écrans ultra-larges), mais elle tient en réalité dans un fichier 1080p encadré de bandes noires.
L’auteur reconnaît d’ailleurs lui-même que les 30 images par seconde sont mesurées en 16:9, et non dans la définition géante de 5 120 par 1 440 pixels. Quant au compteur affiché à l’écran, il est fait maison et n’indique ni la carte graphique ni le processeur utilisés.
Un détail technique vend immédiatement la mèche : le chiffre affiché vaut toujours exactement six fois la cadence réelle (30 donne 180, et 27,6 donne 165,6).
Ce ratio correspond au mode 6X du DLSS 4.5, qui demande aux cartes RTX 50 d’inventer cinq images intermédiaires pour chaque image réellement calculée.
Concrètement, le jeu continue de tourner à 30 images par seconde : la physique et la réactivité à la manette ne progressent pas d’un pouce. Nous avions déjà expliqué le grand paradoxe de la génération multi-images , qui gonfle spectaculairement les compteurs sans offrir la fluidité d’un vrai rendu natif.
Sans preuve formelle, l’hypothèse la plus crédible reste celle d’une simple capture de la version console à 30 images par seconde, passée ensuite à la moulinette de la génération d’images. La manipulation a d’ailleurs déjà été montrée mi-novembre avec une PS5 Pro reliée à un PC équipé d’une RTX 5090 pour afficher 180 images par seconde.
Ce n’est donc pas un montage grossier, puisque l’on voit bien GTA 6 , mais plutôt le mirage des 60 fps de cette semaine multiplié par trois.
Pour aller plus loin DLSS 4 et Multi Frame Generation : le grand paradoxe de la technologie star de Nvidia
Si l’on coupe la génération d’images pour regarder les mesures réelles, le tableau est beaucoup plus modeste.
Tous ces chiffres proviennent des auteurs ou de leurs testeurs (et restent à vérifier de manière indépendante), mais aucun projet n’approche encore les 30 images par seconde en monde ouvert :
Côté juridique, GitHub n’a publié aucun nouvel avis de retrait au nom de Take-Two depuis la vague de mardi (3 007 dépôts supprimés).
Selon la documentation de Vice-Tay, c’est l’auteur de CGBJ qui a choisi de retirer lui-même son projet, dont une branche privée sert de base à la démo multijoueur de jeudi soir .
Pour s’y retrouver dans cette course, le tableau des scores de PortWatch VI reste la meilleure boussole.

X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google In Grand Theft Auto VI , the Grotti Itali RSX is one of the exotic cars you’ll need to track down for Randy’s Wishlist. Here’s where to find the Grotti Itali RSX GTA 6 location and how to deliver it to Randy without setting off its Advanced Tracker.
The Grotti Itali RSX can be found in the parking lot directly across from the front entrance of the Nine1Nine club in GTA 6 . Head to the front of the Vice City club and look across the street to check the lot for the exotic car.
If the Grotti Itali RSX isn’t there, save your game and reload that save . Check the parking lot again each time you load in. Keep doing this until the Grotti appears. In my playthrough it only took me a few minutes before it appeared.
The quickest way to deliver the Grotti Itali RSX is to leave Jason in the car while Lucia fast travels to Randy. Once you get there, you can tell Jason to follow you and he’ll drive the car over without triggering its Advanced Tracker.
If you’re working through the rest of Randy’s Wishlist, you can use the same Advanced Tracker Removal glitch to bring him other exotic cars without having to worry about police.

articles.t: Deux joueurs réunis dans GTA 6 sur PC grâce à un portage privé, avant la sortie officielle
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PC : TeK montre deux joueurs connectés sur un portage privé et annonce 25 à 30 FPS. Le chat de proximité fonctionne aussi, d’après PortWatch VI.
articles.txt:
Deux personnages sur le tarmac d’un aéroport, une sportive rouge qui circule : la scène paraît banale, mais elle réunit des joueurs sur une version Windows encore non officielle. La démonstration franchit une nouvelle étape pour les projets communautaires, sans constituer pour autant un équivalent du service de Rockstar.
Le développeur TeK a publié sur X une courte vidéo montrant deux personnages présents dans la même session, dont l’un conduit une voiture sur la piste. Il affirme que cette version tient 25 à 30 FPS stables et prend également en charge le chat de proximité.
La séquence semble relativement fluide, mais aucun compteur d’images par seconde n’apparaît à l’écran. La configuration utilisée n’est pas précisée et le décor se limite essentiellement à une piste vide : ces conditions ne permettent pas d’extrapoler les performances à une circulation dense ou à une session plus chargée.
Le site communautaire PortWatch VI , qui suit ces projets de portage, a vérifié indépendamment l’authenticité de la vidéo. Il confirme aussi le fonctionnement du chat de proximité, mais ne valide pas les chiffres de performances avancés par TeK.
D’après PortWatch VI, le groupe de TeK travaille sur un fork privé de la build CGBJ , elle-même fondée sur les projets open source VIctory et XCL. Le code n’est pas public à ce stade : les autres développeurs et les joueurs ne peuvent donc pas reproduire librement cette démonstration.
Ces travaux s’inscrivent dans une progression rapide des recompilations communautaires, dont une grande partie du travail repose sur des modèles d’IA, selon TechPowerUp. Le média rapportait la veille que certains projets atteignaient 20 FPS en jeu , tandis que d’autres équipes revendiquaient déjà des résultats supérieurs.
La démonstration intervient alors que des informations antérieures évoquaient une version PC officielle au premier trimestre 2027 et un lancement de GTA VI Online en 2027. Elle ne renseigne toutefois ni sur les fonctionnalités prévues par Rockstar, ni sur une éventuelle évolution de ses plans ou de ceux de Take-Two Interactive.
Faire coexister deux joueurs et transmettre leur voix constitue une avancée technique, mais ne démontre pas la capacité à gérer des sessions nombreuses, la persistance ou la stabilité d’un service en ligne. Pour les joueurs, cette vidéo reste donc une démonstration, pas une version à installer : des téléchargements présentés comme des portages non officiels de GTA 6 sur PC ont déjà servi à dissimuler des logiciels malveillants.

articles.chapeau: Rockstar’s latest is selling about as well as we all expected
articles.txt:
We might have to stop saying something sold like hotcakes and start saying something sold like Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar's latest has sold about as well as we expected, with estimates after only one week putting sales at over 50 million copies . That number will only go up in the weeks and months to come, especially if a new GTA Online mode and a PC version are eventually announced, as rumored .
According to estimates from Alinea Analytics , GTA 6 has sold 53 million copies in the week following the game's release on Nov. 19. That equates to $4.7 billion in revenue. By comparison, GTA 5 only sold 29 million copies in its entire first month . (It has since gone on to sell more than 230 million copies.) Other stats from the report reveal that nearly 7 million players have logged more than 50 hours in the game, with around 250,000 logging more than 100 hours .
The report also states that GTA 6 had an impact on sales for some of 2026's other major releases. On PlayStation, sales of several games (including 007 First Ligh t​​​​​​​ , Resident Evil Requiem , and Marvel's Wolverine ) fell 34% during the week of GTA 6 's release. ​​​​​​​ Alinea Analytics points out​​​​​​​ that this isn't all GTA 6 's fault, as typical sales decay for these titles was also in full swing. Interestingly, sales did actually go up slightly in the week before the game's release, possibly because some players​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​ bought a PS5 and picked up a game or two​​​​​​​ to hold them over until GTA 6 's release.​​​​​​​
Image: Rockstar Games Of the more than 50 million copies of GTA 6 sold, more than 75% were sold for PlayStation 5.​​​​​​​ The report also shows that Xbox sales have continued to decline​​​​​​​ in the days following the game's release. This suggests​​​​​​​ that Rockstar and PlayStation's marketing deal has been a massive success. Prior to the game's release, GTA 6 had been heavily promoted as playing best​​​​​​​ on Sony's console . Granted, PlayStation does currently hold roughly 75% of the console market, making GTA 6 sales roughly proportional to its market share​​​​​​​ . Fresh off the success of GTA 6 on PlayStation 5, Sony has already struck a similar marketing deal with CD Projekt Red for future releases, including The Witcher 4 .
PC players have been left out of the fun so far, with no official word on a PC release for GTA 6 . That hasn't stopped hackers from trying to make their own, with builds making speedy progress after an Xbox executable file was leaked to the public , kick-starting a race to create an unofficial PC port​​​​​​​ . Hopefully, we'll hear official word on a PC release and multiplayer sometime in 2027.​​​​​​​
Grand Theft Auto 6 is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

articles.t: GTA 6 Players Are Not, In Fact, Eating Good
articles.chapeau: Please give me a closer look at that shrimp po' boy
articles.txt:
There are countless ways to spend your time in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You can scoop up pricey bundles of cocaine in a seaplane, do deadlifts to get sick gains, and scuba dive to discover marine life and lost pirate treasure. You can steal an elderly woman's mobility scooter and go to a yard sale to find cool vintage T-shirts . But sadly, one thing you cannot do is savor a delicious meal, whether it's on a solo outing or even on a date night with Jason and Lucia. GTA 6 has a vast, deep world with astonishing attention to detail in almost every capacity. But there's one area where the game comes up surprisingly short — the food.
In the early hours of GTA 6, you'll mostly be downing protein bars, apples, and various bagged snacks from the cupboard in Jason's Key Lento bungalow. It makes sense that these quick snacks aren't rendered in vivid detail — they don't have to be. That said, I was hoping that the game's many restaurants would show us something a little more elaborate.
After all, GTA 6 has more than 350 places where you can stop for a snack or a meal, from expensive fine-dining experiences, to farmers market stalls, to hole-in-the-wall fish sandwich shops. But sadly, pretty much every meal in the game kinda plays out like this. Yes, you can see Jason is clearly eating a hamburger, but the overall effect is not very different from tossing a protein bar down your pie hole.
Obviously, GTA 6 is not Cooking Mama . It is not a game that aspires to be "about food" in any way. Then again, there are plenty of non-food games that feature mouthwatering culinary creations that stick in your memory long after you've finished playing. Consider these examples from Final Fantasy 15 , Unicorn Overlord , and Yakuza 0:
Close Image: Square Enix Image: Vanillaware Image: Sega We know that Rockstar is capable of creating extremely detailed food — the Prairie Box combo from in-game fast food spot Chaco's is a precarious Jenga tower of floppy deli meats, an unholy Arby's nightmare given life. And even if food doesn't serve any particular gameplay function — like granting short-term stat buffs or opening up new dialogue — it's still fun to discover all the different creations. It feels like a missed opportunity to further explore GTA 6 's riff on southern Florida, because Miami in particular has such a unique food scene. Let me get up close and personal with a pile of ropa vieja in Little Cuba! Let me savor some overpriced sushi on the main drag in Ocean Beach! Let me pick up a big box of greasy Chinese with Cal for one of our gaming sessions. Heck, even the Rusty Anchor in Key Lento looks like the kind of place that would make a bangin' coconut shrimp plate.
You can make Jason and Lucia overweight in GTA 6 , so why not let players enjoy it? A diet that consists primarily of protein bars and apples is no way to live.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' Fans Are Pulling Off Perfect Robberies With Only A Six Pack of Beer
articles.chapeau: These GTA 6 fans only need liquid courage to pull off professional heists with no casualties in Rockstar's open-world game
articles.txt:
If you're like me, then you approach Grand Theft Auto 6 's heists with anxiety. You case the joint inside and out. You plan meticulously, leaving the getaway car running nearby with the trunk open. You know exactly where all the cameras are, and have a plan for what to do if anyone tries anything funny. Well, what if I told you that you didn't need to do any of that to steal everything from a store in a way that inches your criminal profile closer to professional status?
GTA 6 gives fans a lot of flexibility in how they approach their Bonnie and Clyde story with Jason and Lucia. Where some people pull off robberies as if they were playing a stealth game like Hitman, others just go in guns blazing . Some people are using this freedom to get creative with their heists, and the results are as hilarious as they are impressive.
Right now, social media is filling up with videos of people waltzing into jewelry stores, six-pack of beer in hand — and walking away with every single valuable in the establishment. Often, these GTA 6 fans don't even bother wearing a mask or pulling out a gun.
In this example uploaded by a meme account on Facebook, for example, Jason pulls off a beer-bottle robbery with the nonchalance of someone picking up a prescription at the pharmacy. Jason even stops to eat an apple before actually breaking any displays. Later, he smokes a cigarette while walking out with bags full of loot in front of nearby NPCs.
The trend is catching on, judging from other viral videos showing similar shenanigans. In this video by 1-Up Gaming, the alarm does go off — but Jason turns it off within seconds. The guards almost seem confused by what's going on, since Jason technically doesn't have a weapon drawn​​​​​​​ .
Some variations show Jason actively drinking during the robbery.​​​​​​​ In this case, the player does pull out a gun to threaten an employee, but no shots are fired.

articles.t: Mercer County has the most GTA 6-ready internet in Ohio, study finds
articles.chapeau: As shoppers pick up new consoles in the Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales to play GTA 6, a new study has revealed the Ohio counties with the most GTA 6-ready internet, with Mercer County taking t…
articles.txt:
These are the Ohio counties with the most GTA 6-ready internet, with Mercer County topping the list
As shoppers pick up new consoles in the Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales to play GTA 6, a new study has revealed the Ohio counties with the most GTA 6-ready internet, with Mercer County taking the top spot.
The study conducted by board and card game experts Playiro analyzed Federal Communications Commission coverage data for all 3,142 US counties to establish where homes can get a broadband connection of 250Mbit/s or more.
As a general rule, 250Mbit/s is enough to download GTA 6 in around two hours, and that includes streaming a film in 4K at the same time.
Mercer County , home to Celina, has the most GTA 6-ready internet in Ohio, with 22,014 homes able to get a 250Mbit/s connection, or 99.2% of the total. In fact, the county ranks 214th out of more than 3,000 counties across the US.
Ohio ranks 31st out of all 50 states, with 92.3% of homes able to get 250Mbit/s against 93.9% across the US. In total, 451,590 homes across the state cannot get a 250Mbit/s connection, which is 7.7% of its 5,827,740 homes.
North Dakota has the most GTA 6-ready internet out of all 50 states, with 99.3% of homes able to get the speed. Massachusetts and New Jersey rank second and third respectively.
The county with the second most GTA 6-ready internet is Van Wert County . Van Wert County has 98.8% of homes able to get the speed, with 13,814 homes in total able to get 250Mbit/s.
Allen County ranks third with 98.74% of homes able to get the speed.
In fourth place is Hardin County . The county has 98.73% of its homes able to get 250Mbit/s, which is 14,095 homes.
With 98.67% of homes able to get the speed and in fifth place is Hamilton County , home to Cincinnati.
The county with the sixth most GTA 6-ready internet in the state is Hancock County with 98.66% of homes able to get 250Mbit/s.
Franklin County , home to Columbus, ranks seventh, with 632,640 homes able to get the speed.
Summit County has the eighth most GTA 6-ready internet in the state, with 98.2% of homes able to get 250Mbit/s.
Cuyahoga County , home to Cleveland, has the ninth most GTA 6-ready internet with 98.1% of homes able to get the speed.
Rounding out the top ten is Butler County , with 97.7% of homes able to get a 250Mbit/s connection.
Lawrence County has the least GTA 6-ready internet in Ohio, with just 34.3% of homes able to get the speed.
Top 10 counties in Ohio by share of homes that can get 250Mbit/s
Adam Davis Fernsby , Founder of Playiro , commented on the findings:
“Unfortunately a slow connection is a very common problem with a game as big as GTA 6, and this is because so many devices are online in the same home at the same time.
When this happens the best thing you can do is start any big game downloads and console updates overnight, which can sound like a hassle but it is something you can set up in a few minutes.
A good tip is to start the download from your phone with the PlayStation App or the Xbox app, so you can be sure the game is ready to play by the time you get home.
This data might show that some gamers in Mercer County may have been putting up with slow downloads for years without realizing a faster plan is on offer at their address.
Saying this, if you’re still unsure it is always best to check the speeds available at your address on the FCC’s National Broadband Map before you buy a new plan.”
We calculated the share of homes able to get a 250Mbit/s download and 25Mbit/s upload connection in every county and county equivalent in the 50 states, and ranked the counties based on that share. Satellite connections were left out, and counties with fewer than 1,000 homes were included in the totals but not ranked.

articles.t: DeSoto Sheriff Tuggle Warns Parents About GTA 6 | DeSoto County News
articles.chapeau: DeSoto County Sheriff Thomas Tuggle warns parents that GTA 6 glorifies violence against police and urges families to know what their kids are playing.
articles.txt:
November 27, 2026 Jon Myers DeSoto County Sheriff Thomas Tuggle is urging parents to pay close attention to what their children play at home. In a lengthy statement posted Friday morning, Nov. 27, he warned that the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 glorifies violence against law enforcement and runs counter to the values his office is trying to build across DeSoto County.
The sheriff shared the message on his official Facebook page at about 9:55 a.m. Friday under the headline “Parents, pay attention!” It comes as the long-awaited next game in the Rockstar Games franchise draws heavy attention from players nationwide.
Tuggle said that ahead of the game’s anticipated release he asked his nephew to walk him through some of the franchise’s most disturbing and violent content. His takeaway, he wrote, was that the series “stands in direct opposition” to what DeSoto County is working to build: trust, strong community relationships, human decency, respect for women, and respect for law enforcement.
The sheriff said he has no problem with a company making money. His objections focus on what he described as:
He singled out parents, and especially single mothers who he said are “working tirelessly” to raise responsible young people, and urged them to know what their children are exposed to “behind closed doors.”
Tuggle did not claim that video games turn children violent. He wrote plainly that playing violent games “does not automatically lead to violent behavior.” But he said that is no reason to ignore the influences shaping how children understand right and wrong, adding that deputies see disturbing behavior firsthand in their daily work across the county.
He also described his deputies as disciplined professionals who value human life, use restraint, and treat people with respect, and who expect that respect in return. He warned that if a child comes to believe that shooting at or killing an officer is acceptable, and that belief contributes to a real tragedy, the results would be devastating.
“In a video game, you can shoot a deputy, restart, and move on,” Tuggle wrote. “In real life, families are shattered, children lose parents, and lives are changed forever. There is no reset button.”
The sheriff closed with a direct note to the makers of Grand Theft Auto. He said he is not looking for a fight with the company or its brand. But if they object to him educating parents, he wrote, the men and women of the DeSoto County Sheriff’s Office and the county’s municipal law enforcement partners “will not back down from that fight.”
As of Friday afternoon, there was no public response from Rockstar Games to the sheriff’s statement.
Tuggle’s core message was simple: “Know what is influencing your children before those influences shape their decisions.” Earlier games in the Grand Theft Auto series carry an M (Mature 17+) rating from the Entertainment Software Rating Board. Families who want to set limits can use the parental controls built into most game consoles, which can restrict games by age rating, cap play time, and limit online chat.
The statement is the latest public outreach from the sheriff’s office, which recently held a blanket drive running through Dec. 15 and has highlighted deputies’ community work, including a captain praised for helping an 8-year-old girl .
Source: Sheriff Thomas E. Tuggle (Facebook) ; also reported by TVMO Community News

articles.t: GTA VI : un portage illégal sur MacBook Pro M4 Pro atteint péniblement les 6 i/s
articles.chapeau: C
articles.txt:
C'est « le grand jeu du moment » chez les gamers bidouilleurs : faire tourner GTA VI sur autre chose qu'une PlayStation ou une Xbox. Alors que le titre de Rockstar est disponible uniquement sur les consoles pour le moment, plusieurs développeurs indépendants se livrent une course haletante sur PC pour proposer une version entièrement fonctionnelle, en s'appuyant largement sur des outils d'intelligence artificielle. Une démarche qui, rappelons-le d'emblée, est totalement illégale.
Sur PC, le projet qui fait la course en tête aurait déjà bouclé 91,3 % du travail nécessaire. Les résultats commencent à devenir tangibles : sur une configuration musclée équipée d'un processeur Ryzen 7 9800X3D, d'une carte graphique AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16 Go) et de 64 Go de mémoire vive sous Windows 11, le jeu tournerait sans planter autour de 22 images par seconde en moyenne. Le tout au prix d'une consommation de ressources conséquente, avec environ 30 Go de RAM et 12 Go de mémoire vidéo mobilisés.
Et le Mac dans tout ça ? Certains bidouilleurs s'attellent à le faire tourner directement en local sous macOS, en adaptant la version Xbox Series.
GTA VI sera accessible en streaming mais pas sur Mac, PC ou iPhone
Pour parvenir à ce résultat, ces initiatives communautaires empilent plusieurs passerelles logicielles. Rosetta 2 se charge de traduire les instructions processeur, CrossOver (basé sur Wine) assure la compatibilité avec l'environnement Windows, et l'outil D3DMetal d'Apple convertit les appels graphiques pour qu'ils puissent être affichés sur Mac. Là encore, l'intelligence artificielle est mise à contribution pour accélérer le développement.
Dans les faits, on reste très loin d'une expérience jouable. Le projet baptisé Halfwave , qui s'appuie sur un autre effort communautaire nommé VIctory-macOS , illustre bien les limites actuelles. Sur un MacBook Pro M4 Pro doté de 48 Go de mémoire unifiée, le jeu plafonne autour de 3 images par seconde dans une scène de prison et frôle les 5 images par seconde lors d'une séquence en bateau. Un autre essai en définition 1080p a permis de grimper à 6 images par seconde sur cette même scène maritime. Son développeur indique que les sauvegardes et l'exploration libre fonctionnent, mais l'affichage reste plombé par des erreurs d'éclairage, des objets qui scintillent et des décors très lents à charger.
Sur une puce plus ancienne, le constat est encore plus rude : un testeur équipé d'un Mac M2 Pro utilisant VIctory-macOS est parvenu à atteindre le didacticiel d'ouverture et à contrôler la caméra, mais au rythme d'environ une image toutes les deux secondes.
Sans surprise, Take-Two Interactive, la maison mère de Rockstar, ne compte pas laisser ces projets prospérer. L'éditeur a déjà commencé à faire le ménage : une plainte pour violation de droits d'auteur publiée sur GitHub a ainsi visé Leonida , un projet similaire accusé d'enfreindre la propriété intellectuelle de Take-Two.
GTA VI sur PC : comment l’IA transforme le portage sauvage en casse-tête pour les éditeurs
Aussi illégale soit-elle, cette prouesse de bidouillage a quelque chose de fascinant sur le plan technique. Elle a surtout de quoi donner des cauchemars à n'importe quel éditeur qui prévoit de proposer l'un de ses titres en exclusivité sur une plateforme. À l'heure où l'IA accélère le travail de rétro-ingénierie, les frontières techniques qui paraissaient autrefois insurmontables, sont désormais beaucoup plus poreuses.

Rockstar Games TEST - Magnum opus de Rockstar, GTA 6 n’est pas un simple défouloir barbare, contrairement à ce que racontent les profanes du secteur. Il s’agit, avant tout, d’un jeu d’auteurs, riche, drôle, sensible et touchant.
Il est parfois des œuvres qui résonnent en nous comme le souvenir de toutes nos premières fois. Notre premier amour, notre premier chagrin, notre premier voyage au loin… Elles paraissent plus fortes, plus vives, que toutes les fois qui ont suivi, car elles marquaient le passage à une nouvelle ère, à un nouvel âge, celui des découvertes et des possibles, celui dont on ne revient jamais tout à fait. En jouant à Grand Theft Auto 6 , depuis 65 heures déjà, nous avons ressenti ce que nous ne ressentions plus depuis de trop nombreuses années dans le jeu vidéo: une soif d’apprendre, une envie d’expérimenter, un désir d’éprouver des règles qui nous semblaient immuables il y a encore quelques semaines. En les bravant, nous sommes tombés dans un gouffre, un maelström, qui nous a aspirés comme il aspire tout ce qui gravite autour de lui - jeux vidéo concurrents, médias, cinéma, réseaux sociaux… -, jusqu’à ne plus laisser d’autre horizon que le sien.
PODCAST - Écoutez le club Le Figaro Culture avec Jean-Christophe Buisson TV ce soir : retrouver notre sélection du jour PODCAST - Écoutez le dernier épisode de notre série Questions Tech GTA 6 n’est pas un défouloir bas du front, comme tentent de le faire croire polémistes, rétrogrades et profanes, qui ne se sont toujours que fondés sur les on-dit de ceux qui ne savent pas et le font savoir. Il n’est pas, non plus, qu’un simple divertissement réservé aux masses, à oublier aussitôt la soirée terminée et les amis échappés. GTA 6 est un jeu d’auteurs - riche, critique, drôle, touchant, émouvant, sensible et intime. Il est capable de faire cohabiter la vulgarité la plus crasse avec la poésie la plus douce; le chaos avec la grâce; le rire avec la mélancolie. Il est, surtout, une œuvre profondément humaine: aucune intelligence artificielle n’a été utilisée lors de sa confection, longue d’une décennie, qui a mobilisé 4500 personnes dans des studios situés aux quatre coins du monde. Il s’agira d’ailleurs, probablement, de la dernière superproduction vidéoludique à ne pas faire appel à l’IA pour limiter les coûts et les temps de développement. Car il est aussi la fin d’une époque. Le passage à une nouvelle ère…
Même pour nous, Grand Theft Auto 6 , disponible depuis le 19 novembre sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series, est une anomalie. GTA 5 en son temps nous avait laissés quasiment de marbre. Sa fin cassée, ruinant un scénario qui partait pourtant bien, sa superficialité, et sa liberté proclamée mais jamais vraiment vécue, la faute à des activités finalement limitées, avaient eu raison de notre enthousiasme. Mais de GTA , ce sixième opus principal n’en a désormais plus que le nom. Rockstar s’est ici plus inspiré de ses deux Red Dead Redemption ( RDR , 2010 et 2018) que de n’importe quel autre de ses titres, afin de donner à son nourrisson ce qui manquait aux aînés: un hyperréalisme qui trouble la frontière entre virtuel et réalité.
De cet hyperréalisme, les profanes cités plus haut n’en retiendront sûrement que l’ultraviolence. Comme tout GTA , il est effectivement possible de mener des fusillades de masse, des carnages en camion, des braquages qui tournent…
Cet article est réservé aux abonnés. Il vous reste 77% à découvrir.

articles.t: Forza Horizon 6 Still Beats GTA 6 in One Key Way
articles.chapeau: There's driving and there's racing, and only one game excels at both
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games is justifiably proud of everything it put into Grand Theft Auto 6 , and one technical detail the studio has taken the time to highlight is the game's vehicle physics simulation. According to Ben Lyons, Rockstar's technical director for physics, some of the team started building and racing cars after finishing Grand Theft Auto 5 , even winning in their class at the Nürbrugring 24 hours.
"This taught us a huge amount about how to modify, design, and set up real cars to go fast and what happens to them when things go wrong, like bursting tires and crashing," Lyons told Polygon in a statement. (As if to underline the point, Lyons' LinkedIn profile pic shows him proudly holding up a blown racecar tire in a pit garage.) "We also took the same approach with rally-racing dirt bikes — it’s important to us to understand the difference between racing on two and four wheels and on- versus off-road so we can give our players as convincing authentic experience as we can," he said. "For this game, we completely rewrote the vehicle simulation for every vehicle type so we could add more detail and realism, as well as authenticity and believability, to the game."
Knowing how detail-obsessed Rockstar's developers are, and how seemingly limitless their resources were , I wondered if GTA 6 's handling physics would be able to hold their own against the best the racing game genre has to offer​​​​​​​ . My interest was doubly piqued when Polygon's reviewer Giovanni Colantonio told me there was a ton of racing in the game, both in the form of organized events on racing circuits and impromptu street races. Could GTA 6 secretly be a great racing game, along with everything else?
Image: Rockstar Games The answer is: no, not really. The cars are great to drive, and the races can be fun, but the design and technology of GTA 6 are fundamentally not set up for racing, and it shows.
As a benchmark to measure GTA 6 against, I chose Forza Horizon 6 . It wouldn't be right to compare Rockstar's everything-game to the most realistic circuit-racing sims, but an open-world racing game that has entertaining, accessible, and credible driving physics, with a degree of depth, seemed like fair game.
GTA 6 's racing options are hardly minor. Street-racing leagues unlock in chapter 3, but you can roll up to any circuit and start racing, or log some time trial laps, from the very beginning. A racing career is even a viable way to make money in the game. If you have enough cash for the entry fee and to rent a competitive ride (or you could just steal one), the payouts for top-three placements represent a decent profit.
As a driving — as opposed to racing — game, there are a number of things that GTA 6 actually does better than Forza. For starters, there's the clearest fruit of Lyons' racing experience: the damage modelling. It's not as astounding as the soft-body physics in BeamNG.drive , but GTA 6 does have extremely detailed and reactive damage that meaningfully affects car handling and performance as well as smashing and peeling away body panels. Big plus.
I've already written about GTA 6 's genius use of the PS5 DualSense controllers' adaptive triggers to allow for easy, relaxed driving at cruising speeds when exploring or just driving from place to place. That's something I wish Forza Horizon could have. And while Forza Horizon 6 's Japan has more outright beautiful scenery than GTA 6 's Leonida, the incredible richness and detail of Rockstar's game makes it an equal or greater pleasure to explore. The roads are much busier with traffic, all of which seems to be driven by reactive (if somewhat chaotic) humans rather than Forza's silent automatons. Also — not an insignificant detail when it comes to the cruising experience — the radio stations are much better.
For sheer driving pleasure, I wouldn't put GTA 6 ahead of Forza, but it's not far behind. The rolling gait of its soft-suspension civilian rides makes them fun (if not easy) to chuck around, and drifts and tail-wagging burnouts are easy and satisfying to pull off. You get a good sense of the surface you're driving on when off-roading, and the world around you has much more credible and reactive physics than it does in Forza, including things like mud and street furniture (which, in Forza, all appears to be made from either balsa wood or the hardest substance known to man).
But anywhere where you care to examine the games' racing chops, Forza wins out. GTA 6 's car customization has great co

articles.t: 209GB GTA 6 'PC version' appears on Russian torrent site
articles.chapeau: The 208.62GB repack uses the VIctory compatibility layer to run the leaked Xbox Series X|S build on Windows, though performance remains limited.
articles.txt:
A 208.62GB GTA 6 repack on a Russian torrent site uses VIctory to run a leaked Xbox Series X|S build on Windows, not a native PC version. Reported performance is poor and inconsistent, and the anonymous download poses a security risk; its claims lack reliable benchmarks.
As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. TweakTown may also earn commissions from other affiliate partners at no extra cost to you.
GTA 6 has been out on PS5 and Xbox for about a week, and a supposed PC version has now appeared on a Russian torrent site. According to HKEPC , a 208.62GB repack labeled as a GTA 6 "Recomp" for PC showed up on the file-sharing site Rutor on November 26. It is marked as version 1.0.2.1, claims to be portable with no installation required, and uses the VIctory runtime.
As we covered before , this isn't a native PC build from Rockstar. VIctory is an open-source compatibility layer that runs the leaked Xbox Series X|S build on Windows. It executes the game's x86-64 code directly, replaces the Xbox system software, and translates the console's shaders for DirectX 12.
The file size also lines up with the leaked Xbox package, which is roughly 209GB. The recomp label is a little misleading, too, as most of these projects rely on compatibility and translation layers rather than true static recompilation. The torrent listing claims the following system requirements:
Performance reports are all over the place. Reddit users who claim to have tried the repack report between 10 and 30 FPS on systems with 32GB of RAM and 16GB of VRAM. Even then, they describe very low rendering resolutions, overly dark visuals, and missing or flickering textures.
Another claim circulating in a Reddit thread suggests the game can reach 30 FPS on an RTX 4070. That's unverified, and the RTX 4070 has 12GB of VRAM, below the listing's own stated 16GB minimum, so take that claim with a grain of salt.
2 PortWatch VI tracks unofficial efforts to run the leaked Xbox Series X|S build of GTA 6 on PC. VIEW GALLERY - 2 IMAGES These figures are also considerably higher than the 3 to 5 FPS reported for the best-known PortWatch VI forks. The difference could come down to a newer build, different hardware, or lower rendering settings, but there's no reliable benchmark to establish how well this particular repack performs.
Interestingly, several reddit comments vouched for the moderation on Russian torrent trackers, saying they'd never had problems downloading from them. One user who tried an earlier port said it ran at around 4 FPS and took two hours to finish the first mission. One of the most upvoted replies even argued that Rockstar deserved this for delaying the PC release.
However, despite the endorsements, we'd strongly advise against downloading this repack. A 200GB file from an anonymous uploader is a considerable security risk, particularly when fake cracked PC versions of GTA 6 are already circulating.

articles.chapeau: We got GTA 6 multiplayer on PC before we got GTA 6's official release on PC
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games finally released Grand Theft Auto 6 this month after fans had waited 13 years . Unfortunately, PC players are still waiting as no PC port has been officially announced . But following the catastrophic leak of an apparent build of the game onto the internet, PC players have begun a race to create an unofficial version of GTA 6 . That race started slowly, but progress has been exponential in only a few days.
If you followed the news in the lead-up to GTA 6 's release, then you are probably familiar with the name Cyberleek . The prolific hacker raised millions of dollars in cryptocurrency by sharing unauthorized clips of Rockstar's big release ahead of launch. With the game now available​​​​​​​ to the public, it seemed like Cyberleek's time in the spotlight might be over. That proved to be untrue on Nov. 23, when Cyberleek released an apparent Xbox executable file that serves as a goldmine for programmers, hackers, and emulation enthusiasts, allowing them to start the hard work of making an unofficial PC port of GTA 6 a reality​​​​​​​.
In the first hours after the build went public, multiple projects posted early builds that could get the game running​​​​​​​ . It was not in a playable state, however, with incomplete shaders and models and extremely low frame rates​​​​​​​ . Now, only a handful of days later, new updates are showing the game in a much better state. Progress on the various builds is constantly documented on sites like Reddit and PortWatch VI ​​​​​​​ . The latest footage shows that GTA 6 is now actually playable on PC, though not completely. Videos of the game's opening missions are common now, with models fully rendered. One Reddit user showed​​​​​​​ that they had gotten the XCL port (one of the more prominent forks) running at over 30 fps, a pretty respectable, stable frame rate​​​​​​​ . The leading build on PortWatch VI, from Belobug, is currently said to be over 90% playable.
This speedy progress is largely the result of generative AI's newfound impact on the hacking scene . The process of decompiling and building a port of a game previously took months and even years to complete, but that can now be done in hours with the right tools. This is often called vibe-coding, which has produced mixed results in similar projects.​​​​​​​ Even Xbox is getting in on the technology, announcing the Xbox Labs division , which CEO Asha Sharma described as "a small group of game makers​​​​​​​ , engineers and scientists whose job is to turn emerging ideas into things our players and developers can experience."
With swift progress on an unofficial GTA 6 PC port, teams are starting to go beyond replicating the console experience. X user TeK posted a video showing​​​​​​​ multiplayer running on a fork of the CGBJ build. The footage shows multiple players​​​​​​​ and vehicles navigating in the game world​​​​​​​ with proximity voice chat. The build runs at a stable 25 to 30 fps. This marks the first time a PC build of the game has shown multiplayer gameplay​​​​​​​ .
Not even Rockstar has spoken about GTA 6 's multiplayer functionality , whose inclusion feels like a foregone conclusion given​​​​​​​ the popularity of GTA Online . While Rockstar and Take Two have taken down at least one leading Discord server in the PC port race, the use of AI tools has created something of a hydra, in which more heads always pop up after one is cut off. GTA 6 is already impressive on consoles​​​​​​​ , but a PC release is even more anticipated as leaks reveal it is likely to have greater graphical fidelity and performance.

Pour cela, il suffit d'explorer l'immense carte de GTA 6. Et pour débusquer le premier clin d'œil, il faut zoomer à l’est de Vice City, réplique de Miami dans le jeu. On y remarque alors un lieu : la " Penmarch Isle ". C'est un membre d’un groupe Facebook dédié au Pays Bigouden qui a remarqué en premier cette référence.
Sous les réseaux, certains commentaires se sont amusés de ce rapprochement : " Même Rockstar n’a pas échappé à l’influence bretonne ! ", " Trafic de beurre salé à Vice City "...

Même si l’île prend le même nom que la commune finistérienne, elle ne lui ressemble pas vraiment. Après en avoir fait le tour, on ne retrouve malheureusement pas de réplique du phare d’Eckmühl. Mais il y a un port, qui ferait penser au port de plaisance de Kérity ou au port de pêche de Saint-Guénolé.
D'autres internautes ont d'ailleurs relevé que cette île fictive correspond, dans le vrai Miami, à la Isle of Normandy, à comprendre l’île de Normandie... Un endroit où l’on retrouve quasiment que des rues au nom de villes françaises, dont… l’esplanade de Brest !
Certains ont aussi remarqué qu'à l’autre bout de la carte, on retrouve la San Malo Bay, sûrement un clin d’œil à la Cité Corsaire. Une petite référence, sans plus de point commun, puisque l'on n’y voit pas de remparts ou de fort…
D’autres ont aussi constaté la présence d’un pont, qui ressemblerait comme deux gouttes d’eau au pont de l’Iroise, situé près de Brest.
Toutes ces coïncidences nous feraient croire qu’un Breton, ou en tout cas un passionné de la région armoricaine, serait à l’origine de tout cela. À l’heure où nous écrivons ces lignes, Rockstar, l’éditeur de GTA VI, ne nous a pas non plus répondu.
En épluchant les crédits du jeu, on a remarqué que quelques Français ont travaillé à son développement. C’est sûrement eux qui ont pu souffler l’idée. Affaire à suivre…

articles.t: GTA 6 PC : des ports non officiels assistés par l’IA font déjà tourner le multijoueur
GitHub célèbre par mégarde l'émulation PS5 de GTA 6... et supprime vite son tweet
articles.chapeau: Boulette sur X
articles.txt:
L'équipe en charge des réseaux sociaux de GitHub s'est offert un dérapage assez lunaire sur X en vantant ouvertement l'essor d'un émulateur PlayStation 5 dopé par la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI , avant de faire disparaître la publication en urgence. Un impair d'autant plus drôle que la plateforme collaborative appartient à Microsoft, concurrent direct de Sony.
Le message aujourd'hui supprimé (dispo juste à côté) ne prenait même pas la peine de tourner autour du pot. « GTA 6 est enfin là, déclenchant l'une des plus grosses semaines pour le jeu vidéo et l'open source sur GitHub » , claironnait le compte officiel, célébrant au passage le cap des 58 000 étoiles franchi par AnyPS5, l'émulateur PlayStation 5 lancé en août dernier. Comme si le tacle déguisé ne suffisait pas, la publication s'achevait sur une question presque provocatrice : « Changer l'endroit où tournent les jeux franchit-il une ligne légale ? » La vidéo qui accompagnait le message enfonçait le clou. Elle soulignait que la frénésie actuelle autour d'AnyPS5 était directement alimentée par l'arrivée du jeu de Rockstar, allant jusqu'à citer un développeur du projet exhortant ses pairs : « Il nous reste 3 jours avant GTA 6 tout le monde [...] sortez vos agents ou vos devs et au boulot. »
Difficile de saisir par quel miracle un tel message a pu passer entre les mailles de la validation interne. Rappelons que Microsoft a racheté GitHub en 2018 pour 7,5 milliards de dollars en actions. Aussi, voir l'une de ses filiales faire la promotion de l'émulation de la console rivale, le tout en jouant les naïfs sur la légalité du procédé, fait forcément tache dans le paysage. Mais le principal coup de fil passé dans la panique ne venait peut-être même pas de Sony. Take-Two, l'éditeur de GTA 6 , a eu une réponse très claire à la question juridique posée par GitHub : depuis une semaine, ses équipes juridiques s'emploient activement à faire fermer les dépôts GitHub tentant de bricoler à l'IA (vibe-code) des portages PC sauvages du blockbuster. Face au risque évident de s'attirer les foudres conjointes de Sony et de Take-Two, GitHub a logiquement choisi le retrait du tweet.

articles.t: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
articles.chapeau: More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure.
articles.txt:
Easy Perspectives Terms Own question Key Points Following a leak, developers are porting GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering. They are using AI coding tools to speed up the work. Tracking data shows rapid progress across dozens of projects. Some already boot the game and show early multiplayer features. The unofficial builds threaten Rockstar's business model, while legal action against decentralized groups has little effect. Days after GTA 6's record console launch, numerous projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build to PC. AI coding agents are dramatically speeding up reverse engineering and shaking up Rockstar's business model.
A core pillar of Rockstar's business strategy is under pressure just days after Grand Theft Auto VI went on sale. The game had a historic debut on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S with an estimated $3.79 billion in first-day revenue. But a day later, the hacking group CyberLeek distributed a stolen Xbox image of the game, and the executable itself leaked a few days ago.
Since then, a fast-moving scene of developers and modders has sprung up to get the game running on Windows through reverse engineering, compatibility layers, and recompilation. AI coding tools like Anthropic's Claude Code are driving that pace. Instead of spending months manually analyzing code and rebuilding console functions, developers are handing off much of the porting work to AI agents. One group even livestreamed the process.
A tracking platform lists 40 active projects less than four days after the executable leaked. Nearly half of them can boot the game on PC. On the platform's own rating scale, the furthest project is more than 90 percent of the way to a playable PC build.
Some projects are trying to add features including native ray-traced lighting. Gameplay footage of an unofficial PC multiplayer mode surfaced on November 26, and the platform's operator verified it. It shows multiple players moving through the game world with vehicles and voice chat at 25 to 30 frames per second. GTA 6 has officially launched only as a single-player title, and an online mode has no release date yet.
There is no finished PC version ready for the general public yet. The most stable builds are incomplete, circulate in closed groups, or require substantial technical know-how. Even so, this pace breaks a decades-old assumption in the gaming industry. Console emulators often took years after a hardware generation launched, and brand-new blockbusters rarely ran on them soon after release.
Rockstar and parent company Take-Two face more than a technical nuisance. The studio traditionally releases its flagship games on consoles first and follows with PC versions much later. GTA V took about 19 months to reach PC, and Red Dead Redemption 2 took about a year. So far, there is no official PC release date for GTA 6. That approach cuts optimization work at launch and encourages impatient players to buy the game twice.
The online business is an even bigger vulnerability. Nearly 80 percent of Take-Two's total revenue in fiscal year 2026 came from microtransactions and recurring digital spending. GTA Online alone has brought in more than $5 billion so far. A free, community-run PC multiplayer mode targets that financial backbone before Rockstar has even launched its own version.
Past experience with FiveM for GTA V shows how nervous Take-Two is about parallel worlds like this. In 2015, the company cracked down hard on the alternative multiplayer and roleplay mod. It banned developer accounts and, according to some developers, even sent private investigators to the creators' homes to shut down the project .
FiveM grew into the core of the roleplay scene despite that pushback and at times drew more concurrent players on Steam than the base game. Only then did Rockstar reverse course and acquire the development team Cfx.re in August 2023. Back then, the community needed years to build a parallel ecosystem like that. For GTA 6, an early PC multiplayer prototype has surfaced just a week after launch.
A trend that hit other parts of the software market earlier this year has now reached AAA gaming. articles.t: GTA 6 Leaked Xbox Build Boots on Windows at 1 FPS
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek released the missing GTA 6 executable. The VIctory project says the leaked Xbox build boots on Windows, but the world runs at about 1 FPS.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Cyberleek, the name reporters use for the anonymous leaker behind the leaked 209GB GTA 6 Xbox build , released the missing executable on 23 November 2026. An open source project called VIctory now says the game boots on Windows. According to Make Tech Easier and NoobFeed, the project’s README describes menus running at 30 FPS and the game world running at approximately 1 FPS. Nobody would call that playable.
The number reads like a failure, but it works better as a progress marker. A leaked console build that reaches the prologue on a PC is a real step for the unofficial porting scene. An earlier VIctory fork test on different hardware also landed in single-digit frame rates, which we covered in our report on the VIctory fork running GTA 6 at 3 FPS . The new claim moves the needle only slightly on speed, yet it changes the story on whether the files can start at all.
Every claim here comes with a caveat. Reporting describes the files as an alleged Xbox build, not an officially released product. The 209GB size traces to Cyberleek’s own claim. Reports also say the Windows boot, the prologue access and the frame rates have not been independently verified. This analysis separates what outlets reported from what anyone has actually confirmed, and it explains why the gap between the two matters for players, for Rockstar Games and for the wider modding community.

The core news is narrow. Reports date the release of the missing executable to 23 November 2026. That file completed a package that had been circulating since 19 November without it. Without an executable, a build is a pile of data. With one, a technical community can at least try to launch it, which is exactly what happened within days.
The Cyberleek GTA 6 executable matters because of what it signals about the leak’s structure. Console builds ship as a set of assets, engine libraries and a main binary that ties them together. Release only the first two and the community can browse textures, audio and scripts, but it cannot watch anything run. Release the binary and the question changes from what is inside to whether it moves.
Reports tie the leaked material to Rockstar Games and to files from its RAGE engine. They also describe the archive as an Xbox version, not a retail PC product. That distinction frames everything that follows. A PC cannot run an Xbox binary natively, so any boot on Windows implies translation work rather than a simple double-click.
Cyberleek remains a label rather than a person. Reporting identifies no individual, and this article does not suggest otherwise. Readers should treat the name as shorthand for whoever posted the archive and the executable, nothing more.
The sequence is short, and the dates come straight from the reporting. The build appeared first, minus its executable. Four days later the executable followed. Then the open source side moved quickly. Our own earlier coverage of the executable leak and the missing playable PC build captured the mood before the boot claims arrived, when the community had a binary in hand but no proof it could run.
Look at the last column. Not one row in that table carries a confirmation from Rockstar or from a neutral technical reviewer. The story rests on a leaker’s word, a project’s README and a handful of outlets relaying both. That is enough to report, but not enough to treat as settled fact.
VIctory is the open source project at the center of the story. Reports say its README makes three specific claims. The game boots. It reaches the prologue. Menus run at 30 FPS, while the game world runs at approximately 1 FPS. The project itself labels that last result as unplayable.
That honesty deserves credit. Plenty of leak-adjacent projects oversell their progress with cropped clips and vague promises. A README that states a 1 FPS world figure and calls it not playable gives other developers a concrete baseline. It also sets expectations for the many readers who hear boots on Windows and assume a working PC version is days away.

articles.chapeau: Quelle voiture pour semer la police dans GTA 6 ? Ocelot Jugular, Pfister Neon, Coil Raiden : notes du jeu et guides convergent.
articles.txt:
Pour semer la police dans GTA 6, les guides convergent vers trois voitures vives au démarrage : l’Ocelot Jugular, inspirée de la Jaguar XE SV Project 8, la Pfister Neon, clin d’œil à la Porsche Taycan, et la Coil Raiden, calquée sur la Tesla Model S. Toutes dépassent 7 sur 10 en accélération dans le carnet de véhicules du jeu. Pour encaisser les chocs, le pick-up Truth & Justice Caracara fait référence.
Quelques jours après la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI , les guides de fuite se recoupent. Sportskeeda (liste mise à jour le 24 novembre) privilégie l’accélération et la maniabilité pour slalomer dans le trafic. GTA Six Guides ajoute la robustesse et déconseille les supercars fragiles. Des critères cohérents avec la physique de conduite de GTA 6 .
Côté chiffres, Dexerto a relevé pour 126 voitures les cinq notes sur 10 affichées en jeu : vitesse, accélération, tenue sur asphalte, tenue hors piste et solidité. Ce sont ces valeurs que nous reprenons, à distinguer des impressions de conduite des guides.
Les quatre voitures rapides plafonnent à 3 sur 10 en solidité : mieux vaut éviter tout contact avec les voitures de police.

articles.t: GTA 6 Graphics Settings Leak: 4 Consoles, 0 Confirmed
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 graphics settings reportedly leaked for PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and S via a deleted Pastebin. Rockstar has confirmed none of it.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games A deleted Pastebin document attributed to GTAForums dataminer Tex2 reportedly lists GTA 6 graphics settings for four consoles. KitGuru reported that the deleted leak may have revealed Rockstar’s graphics settings for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. Rockstar Games has not confirmed any of it.
MP1st, The Times of India, iXBT.games and GamesRadar+ also carried the story, which kept it circulating on November 27, 2026. The document is gone, so readers cannot check the original page. That gap matters, and this analysis treats every detail as a report, not as a fact about the shipping game.
The timing adds fuel. Players are still debating what a possible PC version could look like, a thread we followed in our report on the GTA 6 leak for PC gamers and its November build . A console settings list gives that debate new material, even if it proves nothing about PC.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The core claim is simple. A Pastebin document, since deleted, reportedly carried graphics presets for the PS5, PS5 Pro , Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S versions of Grand Theft Auto VI. It did not leak a build, a trailer or a story detail. It leaked a settings list, the kind of data a developer keeps in internal config files or debug menus.
According to the reports, the list covered texture quality, shadow quality, terrain detail, hair quality, global illumination, NPC behavior, pedestrian density and physics quality. Those eight areas span both rendering and simulation. Some tax the GPU, others tax the CPU, and a few hit both. A preset that touches all of them tells you how a studio balances the whole machine, not only the pretty parts.
The presence of NPC behavior, pedestrian density and physics quality stands out. Those options suggest the document describes the full game simulation and not just the visual layer. Open-world games live and die by how many people, cars and objects the engine can keep alive at once, so the CPU side of the list may matter as much as the shadows.
Nothing in the available coverage supplies resolution targets, frame rates or a full value-by-value table that we can verify. Outlets described the document in broad strokes, and we do the same. Any site that prints a complete table of exact values is working from a page that no longer exists.
Related guides: From the same topic area, our evergreen pick is PS5 Pro vs PS5 , a page we keep current rather than a story that dates; the Shattered guides hub groups it with the other setup guides and comparisons we maintain, each listed with a one-line description written for it.
Reports attribute the Pastebin to Tex2, a member of GTAForums who is described as a dataminer. Dataminers pull information out of game files, patches and builds. Their track records vary widely, and the strongest ones show their work. A deleted paste with no surviving original shows very little.
The attribution itself comes secondhand. Outlets repeat the name because earlier posts and forum threads pointed to it, and not because anyone has proven who posted the paste. Rockstar has not said whether the document is authentic, whether it came from a current build or whether it reflects an older internal state.
Journalists use a rough ladder for leaks. The top rung is a document the publisher confirms. The next is material several independent outlets inspected directly. The bottom rung is a description of something nobody can open any more. This story sits near the bottom, which is why the fact pattern stays modest: four platforms, a few named features and no official word.
Repetition across outlets does not lift a leak up the ladder. Five sites summarizing the same vanished page equal one source, counted five times. Readers should keep that in mind each time a headline treats a leak as settled when its own publisher has not touched it.
One of the more interesting claims is that the PS5 and Xbox Series X settings match. Reports say both consoles use the same mixture of medium and high presets. If that holds, Rockstar treats the two flagship consoles as one performance tier, which is how many multiplatform studios work when the hardware is close.

articles.t: GTA 6 release produces rash of bricked Xbox consoles, joining failing PS5s
articles.chapeau: Following the GTA 6 launch, bricked Xbox consoles are appearing in droves at service centers. A Polish technician examined Xbox Series X and S units that won’t turn on or crash repeatedly. PS5s have also suffered from apparent overheating issues, exposed by the demanding Rockstar title.
articles.txt:
Instances of dying or dead PS5 consoles have risen since the GTA 6 release date . However, the Xbox Series X and S are not immune to problems when exploring the Leonida map . A repair shop reported an unusually high rate of catastrophic failures for Microsoft’s hardware.
Technician modyfikatorcasper noted that in Poland, Xbox consoles are much less prevalent than their PlayStation rivals. Regardless, they now represent 2 out of 10 systems sent to the company for service. The number of units with issues has increased sharply compared to previous months.
Symptoms include random shutdowns or crashes during GTA 6 gameplay . Other gaming machines have slowed to a crawl or refuse to install updates. In the worst scenarios, a bricked Xbox Series X either won’t power on or output a blank video signal.
The launch of the Rockstar title boosted PS5 and Xbox console sales , while other players may have activated dormant systems. As a result, it’s not surprising modyfikatorcasper would experience a massive uptick in requests. Nevertheless, support subreddits indicate the severe issues aren’t entirely isolated.
Poster Top_Nothing_3145 initially avoided trouble and completed a long gameplay session. Unfortunately, the Series X wouldn't turn on the next morning. Evidence points to a dead power supply, with some readers recommending replacing the component.
Redditor Jastafool could only play the GTA 6 Xbox version for 10 minutes before the fun came to a halt. A local fix-it shop believes a faulty motherboard is causing the startup failure, rather than the PSU.
The less serious cases involve frequent crashes to the dashboard that prevent progress. Rockstar released a patch on November 23rd to address these reports, but it didn’t resolve them for many gamers.
Modyfikatorcasper found that in ailing PS5s, the infamous liquid metal leak is often the culprit. What’s plaguing the Microsoft machines is more debatable, though overheating is again suspected. The diagnostic process is less defined for the Xbox Series X and S, forcing the technician to develop custom tools.
The GTA 6 Xbox and PS5 versions may not be pushing the hardware past their designed limits. Still, the bricked consoles suggest the game is, at minimum, dealing a death blow to already problematic units.

Everyone still here who wants to be? Great. As you probably guessed, the twist in question is the existence of Jason and Lucia's son, Tomás.
After being moved to her aunt's care following her arrest, as shown in the game's prologue, Lucia's primary motivation is to get Tomás back and give him a good life alongside Jason, but none of this was revealed prior to launch – officially or otherwise. This was something that co-studio head of Rockstar North, Rob Nelson, had his "fingers crossed" for.
In an interview with VGC a few days before GTA 6's launch, Nelson confirmed that Rockstar was "never" planning to reveal the twist and, at the time, was still praying no one would spill the beans ahead of schedule. "I am still holding on," he said. "Fingers crossed, how many more days? I'm praying it stays under wraps. While VGC notes that there was a small amount of chatter on forums about Jason and Lucia having a son, these whispers generally didn't stick, and, notably, none of the Cyberleek videos that appeared online before launch showed Tomás. Honestly, that feels somewhat miraculous given how early he's revealed and how frequently he comes up in the story and dialogue.
Cyberleek wasn't the only hacker to target Rockstar, either – there was also an enormous wave of GTA 6 leaks in 2022 – but even so, no baby boy and the driving force of the plot were plastered all over the internet as a result.

articles.t: GTA 6 Metacritic User Score: 5.6 vs 99 Critics
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 Metacritic user score sits near 5.6 while critics give a 99 Metascore from 152 reviews. Here is what the numbers and outlets confirm.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Rockstar Games shipped Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, 2026, and Metacritic now shows two very different verdicts. Critics gave it a 99 Metascore from 152 reviews, while the user score sits at 5.7 from 116,374 ratings . That works out to a 42-point gap once you put both numbers on the same 100-point scale.
The GTA 6 Metacritic user score has become the loudest argument in gaming this week. Some outlets call it review bombing. Others say players have real complaints and deserve a hearing. Our earlier piece on how GTA VI tied Ocarina of Time at 99 covered the critic side. This analysis covers the other half of the ledger, using only figures that named outlets reported and that Metacritic’s own listing confirms.
One caution before the details. The confirmed numbers show that the gap exists. They do not prove why it exists. No study, no Rockstar statement and no Metacritic announcement has established a single cause, so this article separates what the data shows from what outlets infer.

Start with the critic side. Metacritic lists Grand Theft Auto VI, published by Rockstar Games, at a 99 Metascore built from 152 critic reviews. That score matches the all-time high that Nintendo’s Ocarina of Time has held for years. Yahoo’s entertainment desk, in a November 21 report by Marvin Montanaro , noted that IGN, GameSpot and Eurogamer all awarded perfect scores. Eurogamer’s own review called the game an open world of “awe, minute detail and impossible scale.”
Now the player side. Metacritic’s current listing shows a 5.7 user score from 116,374 ratings. On November 21, outlets reported 5.6 from 53,044 ratings. Eurogamer, writing the same day , described the figure as 5.6 out of 10 and said Metacritic classifies it as “mixed or average.” So the average climbed one tenth of a point while the sample more than doubled.
The 42-point gap is our arithmetic, not a figure Metacritic publishes. We multiplied the 5.7 user score by ten to match the critic scale. It gives readers a fast way to see how far apart the two groups sit.
The user score did not start at 5.6. Yahoo reported that earlier observations put the audience score in the 3 to 4 range before it began recovering. Eurogamer said the score “had previously dropped into the red, but has since recovered a little.” Both outlets are describing the same pattern. Yahoo offered three possible reasons for the climb: genuine positive feedback, removal of suspicious ratings, or other shifts in who was rating.
That recovery matters for how you read any single screenshot. A score captured on launch night says little about the final picture. A score captured after 100,000 ratings says more, though even that remains a live average that shifts by the hour.
Between the November 21 snapshot and the current listing, the sample grew by 63,330 ratings. The score barely moved. That stability suggests the average has settled into a band rather than swinging wildly, which is useful for anyone trying to judge whether the early zeros were a spike or a trend.
It also means the large sample cuts against a pure “small group of trolls” explanation. A group of tens of thousands can still be coordinated, but the numbers alone cannot tell us that. The Tribune piece reported that 43 percent of ratings were negative at 101,402 ratings. A coordinated campaign would have to be very large to produce that share.
Critic scores behave differently from user scores. A reviewer gets a copy before launch, plays a defined portion or all of the game, and files a score under an editor’s eye. The 152 reviews behind the 99 Metascore came from outlets that put their names on the work. Eurogamer’s five-star review is one example, and Yahoo listed IGN and GameSpot as other perfect-score awards.
That process produces tight clusters. When 152 professional reviews average 99, almost every one of them sits at the top of the scale. The aggregator has little spread to work with, which is why a handful of lower scores would barely move the number, and why the score has stayed put.
